card.name: Overdose and renal-effect passages, varied words
card.fires_on: Scattered words inside drug-label passages about overdose management, renal effects, or drug interactions, such as 'occur', 'the', 'calcium', 'reversible' and the ends of drug names. No single word type fits.

modes.label: Overdose management wording
modes.description: Words in overdose or antidote instructions, including drug-name endings and 'calcium' before 'salt' or 'disodium'.

modes.label: Renal and pregnancy effect statements
modes.description: Words describing kidney effects or placental transfer, such as 'reversible' or 'maternal'.
